what_this_is: The four owner inputs that BLOCK the public plugin candidate. The build refuses with a typed, non-zero reason until each is supplied. This file is a template with the exact shape; it is NOT an approval and the agent may not fill it.

derivations.skill: <one of the eight frozen skill names>
derivations.source_sha256: <copy the value for that path out of evidence/08_PLUGIN/FROZEN_SOURCE_LEDGER.json; do NOT retype it>
derivations.approval_receipt: <ticket / ADR / message id that records the approval>

supply_1_derivations.why: Every one of the eight SKILL.md packs carries frontmatter outside the Agent Skills portable set, so a byte-copy projection is impossible. The body is never altered; only the listed keys move into the metadata map.

supply_2_vendor_schema_and_digest.where: packaging/public-plugin/vendor-plugin.schema.json (already a byte copy of the round's download) and the pin field inside packaging/public-plugin/plugin.json -> extensions['com.pipd.s4'].official_schema_sha256
supply_2_vendor_schema_and_digest.note: The pin must equal the sha256 of the byte copy the builder validates against. The builder refuses VENDOR_SCHEMA_DIGEST_MISMATCH otherwise. The vendor's own validator and the Portal scan remain NOT_EXECUTED and are not claimed by this pin.

supply_3_publisher_identity.why: A public listing is attributed to a verified human publisher. No agent may assert that identity.

supply_4_icons.where: packaging/public-plugin/assets/ (gitignored) and the icon digests pinned in packaging/public-plugin/plugin.json
supply_4_icons.current_state: The candidate generates a deterministic placeholder icon with a stdlib PNG writer so the pipeline is testable end to end. Owner brand assets, and the Portal's icon scan, are NOT supplied and NOT executed.
supply_4_icons.pin: Regenerate or replace, then pin the resulting sha256 in the manifest's icon entry.

owner_only_acts_after_these: create the new immutable release tag and its assets (never rewrite v0.1.1-preview.3)
perform the Portal draft -> scan -> review -> Publish sequence
ratify or reject the Stage A/B candidates
